Preview: The Ridgeline 2P is back in stock. Your discount ends Sunday.
Body: It's been a while. Figured we'd reach out with something worth opening.

Through Sunday, you can take 20% off sitewide — including the Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent (NB-TNT-02).

• 2-person capacity
• 3-season rating — designed for spring through fall; not built for winter alpine conditions
• 2.1 kg packed weight
• Ripstop nylon construction

It's a straightforward shelter for the trips most of us actually take. Nothing more than that, but it holds up where it counts.

Offer ends Sunday. No extensions.
